dialogues.speaker: You Jun
dialogues.text: #{F#Shh! Shh! She's here! The blond-haired Traveler!}{M#Shh! Shh! He's here! The blond-haired Traveler!} Indeed, it is just as Master Taliesin sang of.

dialogues.speaker: You Jun
dialogues.text: "Like" nothing! I shall soon be a bard, for sooth!

dialogues.speaker: You Jun
dialogues.text: Thanks to you, this place no longer requires the services of so many Millelith.

dialogues.speaker: You Jun
dialogues.text: I should have been transferred back to Liyue Harbor, but I've found what I want to do.

dialogues.speaker: You Jun
dialogues.text: And what is that, you ask? Why, it is to follow Master Taliesin and cause songs and ballads to resound on the winds throughout Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: You Jun
dialogues.text: That's right. His "old school epic poetry" really moved me. As such, I've decided to become his very first disciple here in Liyue. I feel like I should also write an epic for Rex Lapis.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you then, raven-haired You Jun.

dialogues.speaker: You Jun
dialogues.text: That's what I think too... Still, I'll work hard under Master Taliesin!
